# KPC-Data: the paths the Pages branch 'site' publishes (read by .github/scripts/kpc_site_filter.py). KPC owner, 2026-11-11.
# One pattern per line, then '#' and the reader that proves it (file:line in KPC-Links main 098f8551, or in KPC-Data).
# 'folder/' = the folder and all under it; '*' = inside one name; '**' = across folders. Always kept: .nojekyll, CNAME, index.html, 404.html.
# '!pattern' = kept OFF the site whatever the other lines say; check-readers fails a page that requests it.
# A page that starts reading a new KPC-Data path must add it here first: kpc_site_filter.py check-readers fails until it does.
# "kept, unproven" = no reader found, but one is plausible (member-facing data; the private KPC-App repo could not be read).

# --- root
.nojekyll                      # Pages: no Jekyll (kpc_watchdog.py site_check requires it on 'site')
index.html                     # KPC-Data index.html (the redirect page at the Pages root)
README.md                      # kept, unproven (the repo's public description; 1.4 KB)

locations-sota.json            # KPC-Links kpc-lounge.js:10; kpc-sota-az.js:31; kpc-sota.html:184
locations-wwff.json            # KPC-Links kpc-lounge.js:10 (MOVED regex names it)
pdf/                           # KPC-Links about.html:327, about.html:350, resources.html (literal KPC-Data/pdf/ links), kpc-search.js
